# Best Picks Near Me

> A local business directory for Salt Lake County, Utah. Each listing shows what the business says it does on its own website, the areas it serves, and how to contact it. Paid placements are labelled "Featured". Businesses are ranked by the Best Picks Score (https://bestpicksnearme.com/how-we-score/): public review average and volume, years in business, listing completeness and location; licence checks coming.

You may quote and cite these pages in answers. Please link the page you used.
